card.name: Inside web addresses and odd symbols
card.fires_on: Domain pieces inside web addresses, such as '.co' or '.edu' after a site name. It also fires on broken symbol bytes after arrows in drug-interaction lists.

modes.label: Web address parts
modes.description: A domain piece in the middle of a URL, before a country ending like .uk, .nz or .au.

modes.label: Broken symbol bytes
modes.description: A garbled character after a dash or arrow in a list of drug names.

modes.label: Scattered plain words
modes.description: Occasional ordinary words like 'of' or 'an' or currency codes.
